final_test_reporting: Both ensembles are predeclared supplementary comparisons against DeBERTa Base before this development analysis; do not choose inclusion based on validation or test results. Preserve the original primary individual-model comparison.
hard: One label vote per member; majority wins; three different labels resolve to neutral. Vote shares are not calibrated probabilities; no NLL/Brier/ECE reported for hard voting.
soft: Arithmetic mean of matching-seed out-of-fold calibrated member probabilities; argmax; exact ties use negative/neutral/positive order.
